capabilities: Show native OS file and folder icons beside local links
Show website favicons beside web links
Configure icon size, link types, and per-extension or per-domain exclusions
Choose a favicon provider or disable web favicons
Include or omit icons in PDF exports
extras: On macOS, Linux, and mobile, local links fall back to built-in file-type icons; favicon providers receive the domain names of rendered links, and a direct provider option sends requests to each linked site instead.
motivation: To bring the familiar application icons from Windows File Explorer and browser bookmarks into Obsidian notes.
problem: Obsidian shows links as plain text, so attached spreadsheets, PDFs, folders, and websites are hard to tell apart at a glance.

relations.evidence: derives some design patterns, configurations, and core web favicon concepts from the original GPL-3.0 licensed Link Favicons

requires.name: OS file associations and local files/folders on the device
favicon provider (Google, DuckDuckGo, Icon Horse) for web icons

summary: Renders native OS file/folder icons and website favicons next to links in Live Preview and Reading view.
